title: Ramsays' $14,000 retrieval reenactment
plain: The Ramsey family restaged the recovery of a crashed craft at Hart Canyon near Aztec, New Mexico, where they say a flying saucer carrying alien bodies once came down, and the reenactment cost them "in excess of $14,000 that week." Suzanne Ramsey, a researcher who took part, tells it herself. The Ramseys did it to test how such a recovery could have been carried out on that ground, which would support the crash story.
